title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 89
description: Ten questions on Psalms 89: Yahweh's loving kindness and faithfulness, his covenant with David, and a lament over the fallen king.

questions.text: What will the psalmist sing of forever, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever."

questions.text: To whom has God sworn, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: In verse 3 God says: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant."

questions.text: What does Yahweh do when the waves of the sea rise up?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them."

answers.text: He sends them over the land

questions.text: Which two mountains rejoice in God's name in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name."

questions.text: With what has God anointed David, according to verse 20?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says: "I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil."

questions.text: What will God appoint him, according to verse 27?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says: "I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth."

questions.text: If David's children break God's statutes, with what will God punish their sin?
questions.explanation: Verses 31-32 say that if they break his statutes, he will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

questions.text: What is called "the faithful witness in the sky" in verse 37?
questions.explanation: Verse 37 says it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.

questions.text: Where does verse 39 say God has defiled his crown?
questions.explanation: Verse 39 says: "You have defiled his crown in the dust."

questions.text: With which words does the psalm end?
questions.explanation: Verse 52 says: "Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen."
